themes.title: Iran threatens Western leaders amid escalating tensions
themes.blurb: Iran's state media has published a 'hit list' targeting Western leaders, including Italy's Giorgia Meloni, Donald Trump, and others, in retaliation for the death of Iran's Supreme Leader. This theme resonates strongly across multiple countries, with leaders expressing solidarity and condemning the threats.

themes.title: Right-wing parties push anti-immigration policies in Europe
themes.blurb: Far-right and right-wing parties across Europe are intensifying their focus on anti-immigration policies, with Germany's AfD and Spain's Vox leading the charge. These policies include stricter deportation measures, opposition to asylum seekers, and calls for national priority in citizenship.

themes.title: Milei’s ‘shutdown’ policy sparks global right-wing emulation

This theme reflects the growing influence of Milei's libertarian approach on the international stage.
